outcome: A battle card can be cast only from hand in a main phase of its owner's turn with an empty stack.
A resolving battle spell enters the battlefield under its controller's control.
A battle enters with defense counters equal to its printed defense.
Damage dealt to a battle removes that many defense counters from it.
A Siege with 0 defense that is not the source of a pending triggered ability goes to its owner's graveyard in the state-based check.
A non-Siege battle with 0 defense goes to its owner's graveyard in the state-based check.
A battle's protector cannot attack it, while any attacking player whose opponent is the protector can; a Siege's controller can attack it.
Only the protector may block creatures attacking the battle.
Rules referring to the defending player for an attacked battle refer to its protector.
A battle has one protector, replaced when another player becomes protector.
A battle keeps its protector when it stops being a battle or copies another battle.
A battle attached to a permanent becomes unattached in the state-based check.
A non-attacked battle without a valid protector gets a newly chosen one, or goes to the graveyard if none can be chosen.
When the last defense counter leaves a Siege, it triggers, exiling the Siege and allowing it to be cast transformed for free.
